description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance payable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payment for workers in specific agricultural trades (cocoa, cardamom, and pepper) based on cost of living adjustments. It falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with public sector service conditions and benefits for workers, specifically addressing compensation adjustments through the Department of Labour rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications.
